label: Market Close
headline: S&P -2.0%, 6th straight loss, VIX 28.44, Anthropic +17% in debut, Intuit -9.7% after hours
stance: Stocks reversed an early gain and every major index closed down more than 2%. Anthropic's record debut did not lift tech.

scorecard.call: S&P 500 down 5 straight; Fed speakers leaned toward more hikes.
scorecard.actual: Sixth straight loss: S&P -2.0% at the close. Goolsbee said inflation is 'way higher' than 2% (12:59pm).
Anthropic closed $97.17, +17% on the $83 offer. Nasdaq still fell 2.3%.

scorecard.call: Midday check: S&P -0.2% at 11:34, nothing tripped, no update posted.
scorecard.actual: The selling came after 11:34. S&P closed -2.0%, VIX 28.44.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Goolsbee sees no clear path back to 2% inflation (4:00pm). Markets favour 25bp on Dec 9 (4:16pm).
10y fell only 1bp on a 2% S&P loss. Treasuries did not hedge equities today.
Gold $3,622, -3.2%, at 6:32pm on hike bets. Euro below $1.10 on French election risk (5:52pm).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P 500 was up as much as 1.3% early before the reversal (4:25pm).
All 11 S&P sectors fell, 10 by more than 1% (6:11pm). Cybersecurity was the only group higher.
All four major indexes on pace for their worst week since April 2025 (5:12pm).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HYG -0.2%, LQD -0.1% at the close. Credit fell far less than equities.
IG OAS 93bp Wednesday, +1bp. Today's sell-off is not in it yet.

items.head: Intuit -9.7% after hours on soft outlook
items.body: Fiscal Q1 results with a weak outlook (4:24pm). Selling Mailchimp for $3.68bn (4:40pm). Shares -9.7% at 6:42pm.

items.head: Ross Stores -6.0% after hours on revenue miss
items.body: Q3 revenue missed and Q4 EPS guidance was cut (4:38pm). Shares -6.0% at 6:32pm.

items.head: Gap +3.0% after hours despite guidance cut
items.body: Comps flat, margin beat, full-year guidance lowered (4:22pm). New Athleta CEO named. Shares +3.0% at 6:40pm.

items.head: Anthropic closes debut +17% at $97.17
items.body: Largest IPO on record (4:17pm). Shares -2.9% after hours at 6:42pm on reports Apple is building an AI agent (5:13pm).

watch.head: UMich final sentiment, Nov 20, 10:00
watch.body: Household inflation expectations, final November read.

watch.head: Fed's Paulson speaks Friday
watch.body: Next Fed voice after Goolsbee. China loan prime rate overnight.

watch.head: Japan core CPI 2.2% vs 2.3% expected
watch.body: Released 6:36pm ET, highest this year. USD/JPY near 160.

watch.head: Iran strike decision
watch.body: Trump weighing another strike on Iran as Hormuz shipping risks rise (1:39pm).
